entities.name: Xu-Ifit
entities.description: A human wizard and Monoist surgeon of the Monasteriat in the Edge, stationed at Susur Secundi.

entities.name: Xu-Ifit's wife
entities.description: Frozen in time dilation in the Sotheran supervoid during her plunge.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Faith of Xu-Ifit; acolytes are experimented upon.

entities.name: Sotheran supervoid
entities.description: Void into which Xu-Ifit's wife plunged.

events.summary: Xu-Ifit's wife plunges into the Sotheran supervoid and is frozen by a gravitational anomaly.
events.quote: leaving her frozen in place by time dilation

events.summary: Xu-Ifit experiments on Monoist acolytes to rescue her wife.

relations.note: Her wife, whom she is trying to rescue.
relations.quote: Xu-Ifit has made it her life's mission to rescue her wife

relations.note: She is a surgeon of the Monoist faith.
relations.quote: Xu-Ifit is a surgeon of the Monoist faith
